plan.encoding: ASCII canonical TSV with final LF
plan.db2_entries: 1..=1161 exact catalog name/FileDataID pairs, alphabetical names and unique IDs

package.manifest: forever-package.json with deterministic per-entry partial-section declarations
package.partial_encrypted_sections_by_entry: For each selected DB2 table with TACT-declared available-source sections, emit deterministic declarations [{lookup, frame_ordinal, decoded_size}]; a complete table has no declaration. The table path binds each declaration to its containing DB2 entry. One or more declarations may tile an extent; no one-frame-per-section assumption is made.
package.declaration_boundary: The plan phase does not add a package manifest field; the per-table package field is implemented by forever-casc and used by the v26 driver, which emits declarations only after 70450 WDC5 structure and zero-fill validation. Offline verification checks exact per-entry declaration coverage and decoded sizes; no decryption is performed.

limits.db2_sections: Structural validation admits 16 total WDC5 sections per table, except Item with 17 total WDC5 sections (one ordinary section plus up to 16 TACT-declared sections). E-frame declarations use the existing CASC max_blte_frames limit of 65,536 per table and 18,576 total; one or more E frames must exactly tile each TACT extent.
limits.db2_structural_values: At most 1,000,000 declared values per table, except ItemSparse at 1,309,884 (19,263 records * 68 fields) and SpellEffect at 1,276,783 (44,027 records * 29 fields); one additional declared record in either exception rejects and every other table retains the default.

source_policy.db2: Only the exact selected build-70450 catalog entries use the disabled-key available-source route. Each resulting partial DB2 is bounded and checked against build-70450 WDC5 structural rules before publication. Complete tables without partial frames retain Metadata and intrinsic DB2 validation during offline verification instead of the partial structural reader.
source_policy.partial_sections: Only authenticated available-source encrypted frames whose decoded coverage exactly tiles the containing selected DB2's ordered TACT-declared extents may be zero-filled and declared per table. Multiple frames per extent are admitted; frame ordinals and sizes must match coverage. Bounded WDC5 framing and zero-fill checks are mandatory; non-zero TACT-declared payload is product_partial_zerofill. No decryption or key material is admitted.
source_policy.failure_policy: A selected entry that fails source authentication, WDC5 framing, zero-fill validation, or a resource limit remains fatal; it is not silently omitted.

verification.scope: offline package integrity, intrinsic selected-DB2 WDC5/zero-fill validation, and exact per-entry partial-section declaration matching

acceptance_matrix.expect: admit only build 70450, wowdbdefs-70450-v1, component mask 1, resident storage, disabled decryption, exact DB2-only options and mandatory declared-skip
accept canonical plans selecting one or multiple catalog entries; render and parse roundtrip without client data
reject a missing or misdeclared partial_encrypted_sections field with product_plan_partial_encrypted_sections
reject provided-salsa20-v1 and db2+maps with product_plan_component_scope; reject other builds/catalogs and any non-DB2 option
accept at most 1161 selected catalog entries and reject entry 1162

synthetic driver publishes partial and complete tables with per-entry declarations; verification rejects non-zero TACT payload, missing/extra declarations, absent declared DB2 files, and missing selected DB2 files; synthetic checks use no real client data and perform no decryption
accept 17 total WDC5 sections only for Item with one ordinary section and at most 16 partial frames; 18 sections reject; other tables retain 16 total sections and no global ceiling changes
accept ItemSparse at exactly 1,309,884 declared values; one additional declared record rejects; non-exception tables retain the 1,000,000 default and no global ceiling changes

accept SpellEffect at exactly 1,276,783 declared values (44,027 records * 29 fields); one additional declared record rejects; non-exception tables retain the 1,000,000 default and no global ceiling changes

allow multiple E frames per TACT extent with exact coverage and ordered offline sums; ItemSparse's 31 frames cover 15 extents; reject crossing, missing, extra or inconsistent frames; per-table limit 65,536 and total 18,576

the exact matching producer passes real extract, offline verify and verify-links for all 1,161 selected esES DB2 artifacts: 1,055 complete and 106 declared partial tables with 478 zero-filled frames / 350,009 decoded bytes; no encrypted-section decoding, full-client, geometry, runtime or distribution acceptance

historical bounded evidence: the matching producer passed real extraction and offline verification for five selected esES tables with one declared partial table, then plan-only inspect and offline verify-links; this earlier evidence alone claimed no full-catalogue coverage or decryption
v16 disabled DB2-only and v25 authenticated partial-Map identities, grammars, and contracts remain unchanged

legacy_preservation.v16_contract: forever-product-v16; Build70450Db2OnlyV1; one to 1161 selected DB2 entries, decryption disabled
